source: Matriz Consolidada de ids de productos y documentos no estructurados.docx (by product ID), cross-checked with Relación Consolidada de Productos del Catálogo y Documentación Legal de Respaldo.docx

documents.title: Contrato Único de Captación y Banca Electrónica CUCBE
documents.notes: Matrix: SwitchBanamex (T&C, RECA 0300-999-038880; also insurance column). Switch is the only Banamex product in the catalog.

documents.title: Folleto Informativo Cuenta Base Banamex
documents.notes: Benefits document of Banamex Cuenta Base. Cuenta Base is not in the catalog (no precatalog record), so it is indexed for institution-level search only; Switch Banamex's benefits document is Banamex_contrato-switch.pdf.

documents.title: Contrato Cuenta Switch Banamex
documents.notes: Switch Banamex's own contract (OR-8-1403, 06/2026); benefits document of Switch. The balance earns no yield (cláusula III.6) and the client is enrolled in Banamex benefit programs; fee amounts are in the Anexo de Comisiones.

documents.title: Anexo de Comisiones Switch Banamex
documents.notes: Switch Banamex's own fee annex (RECA 0300-999-041908, dated 01-Julio-2026): eligible for figure cross-checks.

documents.title: Tabla de Comisiones de Cuentas de Captación - Banamex
documents.notes: Fee table for Priority / Cheques M.N. / Cheques Dólares / Productiva; it never mentions Switch. Not linked to SwitchBanamex to avoid quoting other products' fees. Indexed for institution-level search only.

documents.title: Contrato Único Súper Cuenta Personas Físicas
documents.notes: Matrix: 060014, 06140925, 06001409 (RECA 0300-437-003368). 3072-1 kept from the first relation (contract covers nómina and basic products).

documents.title: Folleto Súper Cuenta Débito LikeU Pro
documents.notes: LikeU Pro's own leaflet: stored under 060014 so LikeU Pro gets API-vs-document figure checks; LikeU and Cuenta Digital Smart still retrieve it through product_scope without figure checks (its fee clause is titled 'Débito LikeU Pro').

documents.title: Folleto Súper Cuenta Básica Nómina - Santander
documents.notes: Own document of 3072-1 (figure cross-checks). Matrix also lists it in the promotions column of 060014, 06140925, 06001409.

documents.title: Carátula de Contrato Múltiple de Cuentas Sabadell
documents.notes: Matrix ID 20_102 (CUENTA RELACION) is catalog ID 20. First relation: Cuenta Sabadell, Cuenta Básica and Cuenta Relación (all 3 catalog products).

documents.title: Contrato Múltiple de Captación NOW Bank
documents.notes: Matrix maps the contract to every INVEX product (NOW - levels NV/NVR 2-4 merged into NW0001 on 2026-11-20 -, Amazon Access, Yaya, INVEX Genera, basic, investment and cheque accounts).
